Description: 32-bit byte memory address driven by master
32-bit write data bus (Master Out Slave In)
32-bit read data bus (Slave Out Master In)
Write enable: 1 = Write transaction 0 = Read transaction
Byte lane select indicators [3:0] for byte/half/word transfers
Strobe: indicates active phase of bus cycle for addressed slave
Cycle: indicates valid bus transfer cycle in progress
Acknowledge: handshake response driven by selected slave
Error: asserted on illegal unmapped address access
